Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Data Protection Law enacted 2023, establishing the Data Protection Authority (DPA) as national trust layer. Identification and Registration Act (Law No. 009 of 2023) enacted. National Communications Act (October 2017) provides telecoms regulation. Draft bills on Electronic Transactions, Cybersecurity, and Cybercrime are before Parliament. GovStack notes 'no enabling legislation for data sharing and data analysis yet' but the Data Protection Law provides foundational framework.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Data Protection Law 2023 allows cross-border data transfers based on adequacy, contractual safeguards, or consent. DPA established. National Data Center planned (operational early 2026) to consolidate critical applications. Horn of Africa Initiative notes 'framework remains at an early stage, with further regulatory guidance and institutional capacity needed.' Limited but developing controls.
